A beam is pivoted at its centre. Two masses are suspended at equal distances from the pivot as
shown in the diagram.
pivot
block X
2kg mass
Which statement is correct?
A
If X has a mass of exactly 2 kg, it will rise.
B
If X has a mass of less than 2 kg, it will fall.
C
If X has a mass of more than 2 kg, it will fall.
D
If X has a mass of more than 2 kg, it will rise.

options.label: A
options.text: If X has a mass of exactly 2 kg, it will rise.

options.label: B
options.text: If X has a mass of less than 2 kg, it will fall.

options.label: C
options.text: If X has a mass of more than 2 kg, it will fall.

options.label: D
options.text: If X has a mass of more than 2 kg, it will rise.
